title: campanula glomerata subsp. oblongifolia
intro: Campanula glomerata subsp. oblongifolia, commonly known as Clustered Bellflower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Campanulaceae. The health benefits of Campanula glomerata subsp. oblongifolia include its potential to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which can contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is needed to confirm the full extent of the health benefits and therapeutic actions of Campanula glomerata subsp. oblongifolia.
